findings_addressed.title: WithdrawTon debited full user ledger amount while recipient received amount minus forward fee
findings_addressed.resolution: WithdrawTon now sends the withdrawn principal with SendPayFwdFeesSeparately, so the recipient inbound value equals the user ledger debit.

findings_addressed.title: WithdrawAth callback/excess TON remained as unaccounted Vault balance
findings_addressed.resolution: PendingAthWithdrawal now stores a refundable TON cap; ATH ack/failure/bounce callbacks credit returned value minus a 2,000,000 nanotons local callback reserve back to the user's internal ton_balance.

findings_addressed.title: Malformed signed external session requests burned message budget after acceptMessage
findings_addressed.resolution: Malformed signed external requests still consume nonce after acceptMessage for replay protection, but no longer debit message_budget_ton unless the request passes deterministic validation and dispatches a publish.

notes: Full deterministic validation after Ed25519 but before acceptMessage does not fit TON external gas credit in sandbox. The accepted invalid path therefore advances nonce as replay protection and preserves budget.
ATH withdrawal TON refunds are capped by the original attached value and reduced by a local callback execution reserve to avoid creating under-backed internal TON liability.
